This character is intentionally invisible or context-dependent. It may affect nearby characters or change text layout when inserted.
The dotted circle is only a preview aid. Insertion sends the original combining mark, which may attach to adjacent text.

A box (sometimes called “tofu”) usually means the text renderer has no glyph for that character. Keywi checks Android’s sans-serif preview and its fallback fonts; this is an estimate for this preview, not an inventory of every installed font. Another app or recipient may render the same character differently.

Some characters are intentionally invisible. Combining marks need surrounding text, so Keywi does not classify their standalone glyphs as missing. The dotted circle is only a preview aid. This catalog lists individual Unicode characters, not every multi-character emoji sequence.

Downloading a font does not automatically install it system-wide on Android or make other apps use it. Apps that support custom fonts may be able to use a downloaded font. The offline library and search do not require any download.
